# Tesseract OCR components

- `tesseract.min.js` and `worker.min.js`: Tesseract.js 7.0.0, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- `core/`: tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- `lang/spa.traineddata`: tessdata_fast commit `87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd`, SHA-256 `6f2e04d02774a18f01bed44b1111f2cd7f3ba7ac9dc4373cd3f898a40ea6b464`
- `lang/eng.traineddata`: tessdata_fast commit `87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd`, SHA-256 `7d4322bd2a7749724879683fc3912cb542f19906c83bcc1a52132556427170b2`
- Language source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

The language files were downloaded from the official `tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast` repository on 2026-09-11. Their hashes above pin the exact bytes used by this application.
